protocol.candidate: Actual production Gait.enter with CONFIG.GAIT.stanceMemory=fresh (baseline/observer legacy); no injected reset implementation. At Gait.enter only reset per-foot filtered friction-load peak Nf to zero. Next pinFeet reads current contact normally. No COM correction. N, Nsum, mass, plant, motor and force gains unchanged.
protocol.limitations: No position/velocity injection, state timing change, new gains or extra force path. Existing horizontal direct support is not replaced by ground-reaction leg actuation. This screen tests contact-conditioned COM control, not completed hand/knee/foot load transfer or human realism.
